# The Name Generators

> Free online name generators for fantasy characters, places, organisations, objects and more: for D&D and other tabletop games, writing, gaming, worldbuilding, music projects and businesses. Each generator page has the generator, example names and an article on the naming conventions behind them.

Names are free to use, no credit needed. If you're naming a business, brand, band or product, check the name isn't already taken or trademarked first.

Made by Rich: https://thenamegenerators.com/about.html

## Blogs & Brands

- [Blog Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/blog-name-generator.html): Generate unique and memorable blog names tailored to your industry. Perfect for starting a blog, business naming, or creative projects.
- [Brand Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/brand-name-generator.html): Brand and product names sorted by industry and feel, from tech and luxury to food, fashion and outdoor. 18 categories, or all of them at once.

## Events

- [Event Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/event-name-generator.html): Names for parties, festivals, gigs, fundraisers, tournaments, quiz nights, hen and stag dos and work events, plus how to check a name is free before you announce it.

## Fantasy

- [Tiefling Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/tiefling-name-generator.html): Tiefling names the way D&D describes them: infernal names passed down through a bloodline, or virtue names like Hope and Torment that a tiefling chooses to live up to.
- [Dragonborn Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/dragonborn-name-generator.html): Dragonborn names the D&D way: the clan name first as a mark of honour, then the personal name, plus the childhood names dragonborn use among their clutchmates.
- [Halfling Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/halfling-name-generator.html): Halfling names for D&D: a homely given name, a family name that started life as a nickname (Thistledown, Puddlefoot), and a personal nickname if they've earned one.
- [Gnome Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/gnome-name-generator.html): Gnome names for D&D: a bouncy personal name, a clan name and a nickname, the three names gnomes use with outsiders, chosen because they're the most fun to say.
- [Elf Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/elf-name-generator.html): Elf names in three styles: real elves from Tolkien's books, D&D-style names, and original fantasy names. Male, female and gender-neutral.
- [Dwarf Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/dwarf-name-generator.html): Generate authentic dwarf names for Mountain Dwarves and Hill Dwarves. Perfect for D&D characters, fantasy writing, and worldbuilding.
- [Dragon Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/dragon-name-generator.html): Generate authentic dragon names for fire, ice, storm, earth, shadow, light, and more dragon types. Perfect for D&D, fantasy writing, and worldbuilding.
